notes: Optimized decoder-layer stage: one MuseGlimmerTextDecoderLayer on a (1, 1) Blackhole mesh, BFP4 weights at LoFi, BFP8 paged KV cache, L1 width-sharded decode residual, DRAM-sharded decode matmuls, explicit 2D prefill program configs.
No capability reduction. The advertised 131072 context is unchanged and the optimization *reduced* the KV-cache footprint by half (BF16 -> BFP8), so the capacity headroom grew.

Prefill and decode were exercised at the full advertised context in the functional stage; this stage did not change the chunking, padding, page-table or position handling that makes that work, and re-tests every non-aligned length the functional stage covered.

The full 131072-token contract is measured on the optimized path, not inherited: prefill at 131072 and 131071 plus decode at position 131071, both layer kinds and both precision policies (the structural bfp8_all_lofi at the 0.995 bar, and the shipped bfp4_all against a length-independence floor derived from its own 1000-token measurement). Every value is in doc/optimized_decoder/pcc/pcc_results.json under test_full_context_prefill_and_decode with its coverage string; the run is doc/optimized_decoder/logs/full_suite.log.
The vision tower / projector are a separate stage; their absence is the stage split, not a context or capability reduction.

prefill.coverage_note: 131072 and 131071 measured on this stage's own prefill path, at both precision policies. The reference is driven with a query-block filter (first, middle and last 8192-token block of each prompt) so one 131072-token host reference per layer kind and policy stays affordable; the shorter lengths in test_paged_prefill_decode_pcc keep full every-position coverage. Every PCC record carries its coverage string and the bar it was asserted against.

decode.coverage_note: Decode at position 131071 on the cache the 131071-token optimized prefill wrote, both layer kinds.

kv_cache.comment: 2 KV heads * 128 head_dim * 2 (K and V) tokens at BFLOAT8_B, which stores a 32x32 tile in 1088 B (1024 mantissa + 64 shared exponents) = 1.0625 B/element: 544 B per token per layer against the functional stage's 1024 B. At 131072 tokens that is 68 MiB for batch 1 and 2.125 GiB for batch 32, both well inside the 34.18 GB device DRAM and half the previous footprint. Cache PCC against the HF reference is 0.9985-0.9995 on real weights (doc/optimized_decoder/pcc/policy_sweep.json).

pcc.bar_source: unchanged from the functional stage; no model-specific exception claimed
pcc.note: The shipped bfp4_all policy is accepted on real checkpoint weights and real activations. Every measured value lives in doc/optimized_decoder/pcc/{pcc_results,policy_sweep,length_dependence}.json rather than being quoted here, because quoted ranges drifted from the artifacts twice. On synthetic i.i.d. weights the same code measures far lower; that is a block-float property of adversarial synthetic blocks, not an implementation defect, and the structural tests run the same code path at bfp8_all_lofi so they still assert the full bar on synthetic weights. The context-length axis has its own real-weight control (length_dependence.json, test_real_weights_length_independence).

full_nope.comment: layer_rope_theta == 0 means NoPE: the HF model passes position_embeddings=None to these layers.

continued_prefill.reason: op contract: the windowed prefill SDPA has no paged-cache mode and chunked_scaled_dot_product_attention has no sliding-window mode, so a continued sliding-window segment cannot read the part of its 2048-token window that lives in the paged cache. The layer raises instead of returning a truncated-window answer.
continued_prefill.note: Not a context reduction: a single prefill_forward call still accepts any length up to the full 131072 advertised context and chunks internally. This restricts only segmented/continued prefill, which later prefix-caching or chunked-prefill serving paths will need.

decode_activation_contract.note: decode_forward returns the hidden state in this layout and accepts it as input, so stacking layers needs no reshard. Prefill activations stay DRAM interleaved. This changes memory layout, not capacity: the decode activation is 32 tile-padded rows x 6656 either way.
